ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 65-70% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the trailing margins and central notch axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) fields occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and a central triangular wedge extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Small, discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are visible on the lower-left and mid-right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile detected along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by sawtooth-like peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a broad convex curve from the lateral tips toward the center, transitioning into a localized concavity immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small, high-intensity circular clusters (3-5 units) located within the dark pigmentation of the central notch area, consistent with sessile barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear pixel disruptions detected: two vertically oriented parallel marks on the lower left lobe and one diagonal mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple linear rake marks across both lobes; slight irregular erosion of the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique comma-shaped dark pigmentation mark located on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe.
